about: sha256 of the two files both model pickers share. atum-desktop src/matrix/ and atum-work atum-work/ each keep byte-identical copies of model-picker-spec.json, model-picker-labels.json and this file; each repo's tests fail when its copies differ from these digests. Change one copy: copy all three files to the other repo and update the digests (shasum -a 256).
